steps.name: list-release-gsm-package-gates
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin main
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-release-gsm-audit-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" origin/main >/dev/null
cd "$WORK"
echo "SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
rg -n 'GsmShellMediaProtocol\.S8_PACKAGE|\.S8_PACKAGE|\.gsmbinder|CallMediaBackendMode|LocalAdbGsmPolicy\.(START|STATUS)' app/src/main scripts | head -n 190
echo "AUDIT_DONE=true"
